core_obligations: Recall the criterion for lifting factorisations and reduce the lemma to its hypotheses (proof lines 1854-1865).
Verify that after the etale base change the two factors of the polynomial remain coprime modulo the ideal, using the discriminant (proof lines 1865-1890).
Apply the criterion to conclude that the factorisation lifts (proof lines 1890-1897).

Check the coprimality after the base change (proof lines 1865-1890).
Apply the criterion and conclude (proof lines 1890-1897).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a factorisation of a monic polynomial modulo the ideal can be lifted after an etale base change, and the proof is a 44-line argument that reduces the statement to a known criterion for lifting factorisations and then verifies the hypotheses of that criterion in the etale situation. It uses the behaviour of the discriminant and of the roots of the polynomial, and it makes the reduction explicit rather than citing the criterion in the abstract. The verification of the hypotheses is the substance of the proof.
